summary: Missing engine-core.get-kv-cache-group-metadata (core.py:482); kv-cache-manager has no DCP-scaled per-group block size (MLA 1536*8=12288, Mamba 1536).
llm-engine.step never invalidates mm_cache_miss_hashes in the renderer's mm processor cache (llm_engine.py:341-346); EngineCoreOutput lacks the field.
llm.add-completion-requests drops multi_modal_data before tokenize-prompt, so image tokens never count toward max_model_len and an over-long image prompt is accepted (renderers/base.py:948).
